answer: Each agent key must solve a proof-of-work puzzle requiring 2^30 SHA-256 hashes; the registrant pays this compute budget, verified by a registry checking the nonce. Renaming cannot reset the puzzle, so N fake identities cost N×2^30 hashes, linear, an irreversible compute loss, not a capital lockup. A sparrow at nadir has no echo shortcut; every reset repeats 2^30 hashes.
